rows.q: List my Pearhead infant learning set, model 87150, like new, $12.

cards.requestText: Recall check: Pearhead Infant Learning Toy Set, model 87150

partnerAnswers:
**Likely recalled.** Model 87150 is listed in an official U.S. recall notice.

**Pearhead Recalls Infant Learning Toy Sets Due to Choking Hazard; Violation of Federal Regulations for Rattles**
- **Date:** 2025-01-30
- **Source:** U.S. CPSC
- **Hazard:** The wooden egg-shaped rattle in the recalled learning sets can get lodged in a child's throat, which is a choking hazard. It also violates federal rules for infant rattles.
- **What to do:** Stop using the egg shaker immediately. Contact Pearhead about returning the product for a free replacement and refund. Pearhead is contacting known purchasers directly.
- **Units:** About 2,700 in the U.S., plus 288 in Canada.
- **UPC listed:** 698904871507
- **Link:** https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2025/Pearhead-Recalls-Infant-Learning-Toy-Sets-Due-to-Choking-Hazard-Violation-of-Federal-Regulations-for-Rattles

I searched the U.S. CPSC and Health Canada recall databases, which held 3,339 notices, with the newest dated 2026-11-19. A match here does not tell me whether any other unit is affected.

rows.q: List my Fisher-Price Rock 'n Play sleeper, good condition, $25.

cards.requestText: Recall check: Fisher-Price Rock 'n Play sleeper, no model number known

partnerAnswers:
**Level: likely recalled.** The Rock 'n Play sleeper is covered by official recall notices for all models, so a Rock 'n Play at any model number falls under them.

**Main notices (both U.S. CPSC):**

| Date | Title | Hazard | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2023-01-09 | [Fisher-Price Reannounces Recall of 4.7 Million Rock 'n Play Sleepers; At Least Eight Deaths Occurred After Recall](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2023/Fisher-Price-Reannounces-Recall-of-4-7-Million-Rock-n-Play-Sleepers-At-Least-Eight-Deaths-Occurred-After-Recall) | Infant deaths. Babies rolled from back to stomach or side while unrestrained. | Stop using it now and contact Fisher-Price for a refund or voucher. Selling or giving away recalled sleepers is illegal. |
| 2019-04-12 | [Fisher-Price Recalls Rock 'n Play Sleepers Due to Reports of Deaths](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2019/Fisher-Price-Recalls-Rock-n-Play-Sleepers-Due-to-Reports-of-Deaths) | Same hazard. About 4.7 million units. | Stop using it immediately and contact Fisher-Price for a refund or voucher. |

**Other Fisher-Price notices that may also apply to your gear:**
- **2021-06-03, 4-in-1 Rock 'n Glide Soothers and 2-in-1 Soothe 'n Play Gliders:** infants placed unrestrained and later found on their stomach are at risk of suffocation. Stop using the recalled product and contact Fisher-Price for a refund. [Notice](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2021/Fisher-Price-Recalls-4-in-1-Rock-n-Glide-Soothers-After-Four-Infant-Deaths-2-in-1-Soothe-n-Play-Gliders-Also-Recalled). These are different products, so check whether yours is one of them.
- **2013-01-08, Newest Rock 'n Play Infant Sleepers:** mold can grow under the removable seat cushion. Check for dark brown, gray or black spots, and stop using the sleeper if you find mold. [Notice](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2013/Fisher-Price-Recalls-to-Inspect-Rock-N-Play-Infant-Sleepers-Due-to-Risk-of-Exposure-to-Mold).

If you have the model number or UPC from the label, I can check it more precisely. This search covered 3,339 U.S. and Canadian notices, with the newest dated 2026-11-19. No match was found for any product outside these notices, and this does not confirm that any particular sleeper is safe.
